connector.name: Nexus Legal
connector.registryDescription: International legal analysis (ISO 31000) across 63 jurisdictions - 15 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at legal.nexusquantum.legal over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the djtellado account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NEXUS_API_KEY
env.description: Personal API key (format `nlk_*`) with `mcp` scope. Generate one at https://nexusquantum.legal/developers (select 'Servidor MCP' when creating the key).

env.name: NEXUS_BASE_URL
env.description: Override base URL of the Nexus backend. Defaults to https://nexusquantum.legal. Change only for self-hosted or staging environments.

env.name: NEXUS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for long-running analyses. Default 180000 (3 minutes).
